repositories.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 AI agents 的 HTML 到视频渲染工具，可用 HTML 描述画面并生成视频。

repositories.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repositories.description_zh: 微软开源的 Python 工具，可将文件和 Office 文档转换为 Markdown，适合文档处理、知识库整理和 AI 工作流预处理。

repositories.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 AI coding agents 的上下文窗口优化工具，可压缩工具输出、持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 管理多平台路由。

repositories.description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 AI agents 的隐身 headless browser，可作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 替代方案，用于应对 Cloudflare、bot detection 和反爬检测。

repositories.description: 本项目采用 CC BY-NC-SA 协议，禁止任何商业化行为，任何衍生项目必须保留本项目地址并以相同协议开源

repositories.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
repositories.description_zh: 用 swarm intelligence 和 AI agents 自动化市场分析、风险管理与交易执行，快速搭建自主 hedge fund。

repositories.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
repositories.description_zh: 字节跳动开源的长任务 SuperAgent harness，结合 sandbox、记忆、工具、skills、subagents 和消息网关，处理研究、编码和内容创作任务。

repositories.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
repositories.description_zh: Lightpanda 是为 AI 和自动化场景设计的 headless browser，强调更轻量的浏览器执行环境。
用于创建和分享 3D 建筑项目的在线编辑器，适合快速搭建、展示和协作查看空间设计。
